Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations
Migrations: schema changes written as classes, and the table that records which ones ran.

An application lists its Migration instances explicitly; nothing is found by scanning the classpath, which keeps the code working on Android and with code shrinkers. A MigrationRepository keeps the names of the migrations that ran and the batch each ran in.
